title: Invertible sheaves on affine space over a field are trivial
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $n\geq0$ an integer. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}(k[t_1,\ldots,t_n])$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. For every invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $M$ [def-sc-invertible-module], there is an $\mathcal O_X$-linear isomorphism $M\cong\mathcal O_X$.

source.place: Tag 0BDA, lemma-open-subscheme-UFD, clause (2), with R=k and the whole affine space; its proof uses polynomial factoriality and triviality of invertible modules over a UFD.

proof.text: Put A=k[t_1,...,t_n] and X=Spec A. By [lem-sfb-polynomial-field-ufd], A is a unique factorization domain, including n=0. Transport its domain and unique-factorization structures across Scheme.ΓSpecIso to B=Γ(X,⊤).

By [lem-sc-affine-invertible-sections] on the affine open X, N=Γ(X,M) is an invertible B-module. Since B is a UFD, [lem-sfb-ufd-invertible-module-trivial] supplies a B-linear equivalence e:N≃B (in Lean: Module.Invertible.free_iff_linearEquiv and the trivial Picard group instance). Thus r↦r•e⁻¹(1) is bijective, since this map is e⁻¹.

source.place: Tag 0BDA, lemma-open-subscheme-UFD, proof restricted to the whole affine space: polynomial factoriality and the affine case of Tag 0BCH.

proof.text: Use the already proved affine criterion AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFreeGenerator_of_bijective_smul from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.InvertibleSections: the section s=e⁻¹(1) is a free sheaf generator. Explicitly form the compatible family of restrictions s|_U, and let φ:𝒪_X→M be multiplication by this family, using SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv. On each open U the generator property says φ_U is bijective. The underlying presheaf functor reflects isomorphisms, so φ is an isomorphism. Its inverse gives M≅𝒪_X. This uses a proved source-library criterion instead of reconstructing the affine tilde equivalence.

source.place: Tags 01HV and 01IB: an affine module basis trivializes its associated quasi-coherent sheaf; implemented by the proved affine free-generator criterion in InvertibleSections.lean.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BDA, lemma-open-subscheme-UFD, clause (2), whole affine space; UFD Picard triviality (0BCH), using the proved source-library affine free-generator criterion for the final sheaf isomorphism.
